key_terms.صَفِّينَ: Ṣiffīn, the location of the battle between Imam Ali and Mu'awiya

ai.seo_question: What topics does Imam Ali cover in his sermon after the Battle of Ṣiffīn?
ai.summary: This heading introduces a pivotal sermon by Imam Ali (peace be upon him) delivered post-Battle of Ṣiffīn, serving as a diagnostic critique of the socio-political landscape of his time. It structurally contrasts the moral decay of the Jahiliyyah era with the spiritual purity of the Prophet’s Household (Āl al-Nabi), while simultaneously identifying the hypocritical factions that undermined the early Muslim community.

en.sayed-ali-raza: One of his (a.s) sermons, delivered after his departure from Ṣiffin,
in which he describes the state of the people before the Proclamation of the Prophet (sw), the characteristics of the family of the Prophet, and then the characteristics of another group of people.
